signature: SUBROUTINE ZUNGL2( M, N, K, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix Q. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix Q. $N \ge M$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q. $M \ge K \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the i-th row must contain the vector which defines the elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by ZGELQF in the first k rows of its array argument A. On exit, the m by n matrix Q.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The first dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by ZGELQF.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument has an illegal value
